mintAuthority.summary: GBPA has five issuer-native deployments. Ethereum, Base and Arc retain a direct EOA fiat minter and an EOA owner of upgrade administration; Arc's complete explorer role-grant/revoke inventory is now corroborated by pinned state. Tempo retains the same minter and sole role/cap administrator, while its token-bound transfer proxy still lacks deployed-executable closure. TIP-403 policy 552 uses built-in always-allow mint-recipient policy 1, separately from its sender blacklist. Solana uses a 1-of-2 Token-2022 multisig; LayerZero program and transfer controls remain separately reviewed under Bridge Risk.

review.evidence: Complete custom role-event history through Ethereum 26110208 and Base 52110932 identifies sole fiat minter 0x5c32ec946062109c61260c738e2fd794b18499d8 and role admin 0xbecf04e2348d00885c62d97d9629c99e581fe00f. On October 5 the Arc explorer's four topic-filtered histories each terminate with next_page_params=null: one MintRoleGranted at 11771886, one AdminRoleGranted at 11475906, and no corresponding revocations. Pinned Arc block 24299510 corroborates both role memberships and owner. This answers the Arc roster question despite primary RPC range/rate-limit failures; it does not certify immutable role administration. Complete 424-chunk Tempo membership/admin-event history at 42377525 identifies sole default admin 0xbecf04e2348d00885c62d97d9629c99e581fe00f and issuers 0x5c32ec946062109c61260c738e2fd794b18499d8 plus token-bound proxy 0x5575151bf6076129d0729c0f40d967d41df34a63. That proxy's exact deployed executable and replacement/authorization closure remain unresolved. New Tempo block 42640743 reads transferPolicyId=552, policyData(552)=(COMPOUND,zero), compoundPolicyData(552)=(sender551,recipient1,mintRecipient1). Policy551 is BLACKLIST with admin 0x5c32ec946062109c61260c738e2fd794b18499d8. The official TIP-1015 implementation documents immutable compound references, mutable simple sub-policies and role-specific mint-recipient checking; built-in policy1 is always-allow. Thus no unknown composite administrator is inferred from zero and no independent native mint bound is asserted. Independent key-custody/recovery/replacement disclosures for named EVM/Tempo controllers remain scoped questions. Solana's 1-of-2 mint threshold is unchanged; its separately inventoried OFT upgrade wallet and unresolved validation closure belong to Bridge Risk. The June-September Nephos reports establish periodic whole-supply month-end reserve reconciliation across the approved deployments and attestation-only supervision, not continuous reconciliation or prudential oversight. Their contradictory assurance disclaimers remain unchanged. Incident absence cannot be admitted while the exact Tempo mint-capable proxy remains unresolved.
